snap general election and trial of catalan separatists driving protests in coming months spanish prime minister pedro sanchez has called a snap general election for sunday april after defeat in the legislature the decision follows on large protests over the relationship between catalonia and madrid and disagreements between political factions in congress adding to debate in spain is the recent start of the trial of catalan separatist officials for their roles in a prohibited independence referendum beyond debate over independence and levels of autonomy for catalonia snap elections will draw an array of issues to the forefront and mobilize demonstrations in spain rising far right support heightens the potential for protests associated with the vox party as well as other political candidates and officials who may express controversial positions demonstrations are likely to be frequent through the springtime with some causing disruptions and resulting in restive behavior recent developments on friday february prime minister pedro sanchez announced that an early nationwide general election will be held on april sanchez has been in office less than a year with a minority government his call for a new election followed the failure wednesday of his budget bill to advance in congress parties voting against sanchez and the budget of his socialist party psoe included the conservative popular party pp center right ciudadanos citizens and pro independence factions from catalonia support from catalan lawmakers had been offered in exchange for concessions regarding catalan officials facing criminal charges for their involvement in the illegal independence referendum sanchez s openness to negotiating with catalonian separatists short of considering an independence vote spurred a protest in madrid on sunday february that drew about participants to plaza de colon the protest was organized by the pp ciudadanos and the far right vox party and was held without serious incident no agreement was reached between sanchez and catalan lawmakers prior to the prime minister s legislative defeat the vote wednesday proceeded the opening of the trial of a dozen catalan separatists at the supreme court in madrid on tuesday the trial is expected to last about three months among some witnesses are former prime minister mariano rajoy catalan parliament speaker roger torrent and barcelona mayor ada colau the arrests transfers and other developments related to the criminal charges against catalan separatist leaders have consistently prompted protests by their supporters thousands of people protested around barcelona on wednesday as the separatists trial opened with about people gathering in pla a de catalunya while some protesters blocked highways and set piles of tires on fire further demonstrations are planned in catalonia on saturday february with at least thousands likely to turn out for weekend mobilizations background catalonian independence has been a highly divisive issue for years though it has not been characterized by the same levels of violence and terrorism as previous decades of basque separatism pro independence supporters in catalonia regularly mobilize to push for their demands with exceptionally large demonstrations capable of attracting more than participants with smaller demonstrations across the region pro unity demonstrations within catalonia are less frequent and typically not reaching the same participation levels though the october independence referendum mobilized supporters of both sides while madrid has typically seen the largest pro unity demonstrations the referendum spurred demonstrations in cities and towns across the country although spain has held three general elections in less than four years the failure of a government budget bill in congress is only the second such instance since when fascist dictator francisco franco died sanchez came to power in june following the vote of no confidence that ejected former prime minister rajoy in spain held a general election triggered by the failure for any parties to form a government following elections in the first such instance in spanish history rajoy was able to reclaim the office of the prime minister in following the psoe s decision to abstain from voting on the formation of a new government a choice taken to prevent a third election being called amidst political gridlock assessment pro independence efforts in catalonia pose a continuing challenge and point of controversy in spain and debates over separatism and degrees of autonomy are likely to be prominent in the upcoming election as parties compete for seats in parliament with an eye to the potential formation of a ruling coalition given the likely event no single party secures an absolute majority smaller parties may prove crucial to getting sufficient numbers to be able to form a government however as seen in the recent legislative results and protest last weekend there is a risk of backlash over the consideration of any concessions to catalonia even in spite of a refusal to consider a legally recognized referendum the pro unity demonstration in madrid last sunday was exceptional for the pp leader s appearance with the vox leader despite past efforts by the more center right party to maintain distance from any associations with the growing far right party the development could signal that pp may attempt to retake power with the support of vox uniting on issues such as the shared opposition to catalan independence vox has been gaining support around the country including winning seats in andalusia s regional elections in december that resulted in vox providing the backing for the pp to claim sufficient support to have a ruling coalition post franco spain has not previously had a substantial resurgence of far right parties in the political sphere however the small but growing vox reflects a broader trend in europe of populist nationalist platforms gaining support and challenging established parties vox is not expected to jump to the head of polls nationally though it could be seen as a potential junior partner or coalition faction to shore up a ruling majority in parliament as well as being staunchly opposed to catalan independence vox backs an array of controversial views including on issues such as immigration and women s rights the far right vox has already been the focus of protests including by anti fascists and feminists as the party seeks to gain a stronger national footing in the april election its events around the country are likely to draw protests such demonstrations could result in clashes between opposing groups clashes with authorities and other unruly actions such as property damage demonstrations regarding catalan independence both for and against also carry the potential for clashes though such incidents typically involve fringe elements developments in the trial of catalan officials in madrid will continue to spur both planned and spontaneous demonstrations pro independence organizers in catalonia have also called sectoral and general strikes in the past to draw attention to their cause and protest grievances such labor actions are capable of causing substantial disruption and often coincide with protest activity seeking to block highways and key roads as well as concentrating outside of government buildings it is advised to exercise caution and avoid demonstration activity when possible due to the risk of incidents of unrest demonstrations are likely to have an increased police presence monitoring developments and localized disruptions are possible furthermore although no specific credible threat is known at this time there is an ongoing heightened threat of jihadist terrorism in spain and around europe the risk of extremists targeting crowds of people including demonstrators cannot be ruled out resilience customers are advised to maintain increased situational awareness particularly in crowded and high profile locations and to report suspicious behavior or items to local authorities

heightened risk of protests in guinea as president alpha conde hints at possible third term over the last few days tensions have been rising across guinea over president alpha conde s hints at a possible third term in office rumors that president conde may seek to amend the constitution to run for a third term began to swirl last year and gained steam earlier this week after a video began circulating online in which he called on guinean expatriates to prepare for a referendum although conde has yet to confirm the rumors officially they have nonetheless sparked a number of protests across the country in recent months several of which have resulted in clashes with police injuries and arrests the potential for additional protests and unrest is likely to run high over the coming days and weeks particularly on saturday which will also mark the tenth anniversary of the september massacre when security forces killed over demonstrators during a rally in conakry recent developments on monday night a video emerged on social media in which president conde called on his supporters to prepare for a referendum the video was filmed during a meeting with members of the guinean expatriate community in new york and featured conde discussing some of the projects he has undertaken during his two terms in office including the building of the souapiti dam at the end of the nearly minute video which was allegedly broadcast live conde stated i ask you to get organized and prepare for a referendum and elections no further details on the proposed referendum or election were immediately provided and conde did not explicitly confirm that he will seek a third term nonetheless the video has fueled rumors that conde may seek to amend the constitution either to remove term limits or simply reset them allowing him to run for additional terms and has been met with resistance from opposition parties the vice president of the main opposition party the union of democratic forces of guinea ufdg has deemed it a constitutional coup d etat while another opposition party the guinea standing party pgd denounced it as a provocation and announced plans to meet with another party to prepare a response there were also reports of several localized protests in tougue and lelouma on thursday and friday but no clashes injuries or arrests were immediately indicated background president conde was elected into office in in guinea s first ever democratic election since it gained independence from france in he was re elected for a second five year term in amidst allegations of fraud and vote rigging his second term is expected to expire in october and he is currently constitutionally barred from seeking another term in office despite the constitutional cap on presidential terms rumors began to swirl last year that he may seek another term in office a move that would require either a constitutional referendum or consent from two thirds of parliament the rumors first emerged around september when the head of guinea s constitutional court kelefa sall was removed from office sall was widely considered the last remaining opposition voice on the court and had previously called on conde to respect the two term limit many opposition activists deemed his removal a critical step to pave the way for constitutional amendments the rumors resurfaced earlier this year when the russian ambassador to guinea issued a speech in support of conde seeking a third term and a memo from the foreign affairs minister on potential amendments was leaked online there have also been reports that billboards and banners have been erected across conakry calling for a new constitution the rumors of a possible third term have sparked a series of localized protests across guinea over the last year several of which have resulted in clashes with security forces notably in june at least people were injured in clashes between security forces and opposition activists in the southern city of nzerekore additional protests have been reported in conakry macenta coyah tanene boffa siguiri kankan and faranah largely in april and may of while most have been peaceful a ban on protests has remained in effect since july and security forces have responded with tear gas and batons during some demonstrations and arrested a number of demonstrators in addition to launching protests opposition groups formed a joint coalition earlier this year against any constitutional changes titled the national front for the defense of the constitution fndc the coalition is comprised of opposition parties unions and civil society groups assessment the latest video has not only fueled the rumors of a possible third term for conde but has also likely further galvanized the opposition movement and could raise the risk of protests and unrest over the coming days and weeks protests are most likely to occur in opposition strongholds such as the middle guinea region as well as parts of conakry but could occur anywhere the demonstrations are likely to take place with little to no warning in an effort to skirt the ban on demonstration and prevent police from breaking them up nonetheless the potential for clashes and unrest is likely to remain high as security forces have a history of responding with force to any opposition gatherings the risk of protests could be particularly high on saturday september which marks the tenth anniversary of the september massacre the massacre which left at last people dead and over women and girls raped and sexually assaulted occurred as security forces stormed the national stadium in conakry where opposition activists were holding a rally against coup leader moussa dadis camara s plans to run for office after he had pledged to step down although suspects have been arrested in connection with the massacre they have yet to go to trial and demonstrations to demand justice for those killed cannot be ruled out opposition parties could seek to piggyback on any demonstrations or use it as a rallying cry against conde and his government s alleged repression additionally the risk of protests and unrest could rise if a date for the planned referendum is set or if conde confirms his plans to seek another term in office as such resilience customers with interests in guinea are advised to monitor developments related to the referendum and maintain a heightened level of vigilance over the coming days and weeks particular caution should be exercised near government buildings and public gathering places especially on saturday september additionally all protest related activity rallies and large crowds should be avoided due to the potential for violence

dutch police foiled major terror plot arrested seven people seven people have been arrested in the netherlands for allegedly planning to carry out a terror attack in the country the suspects had been acquiring weapons and explosives materials prompting police who had been monitoring the group to detain the suspects over concerns an imminent strike or several could have been nearing while specific targets are not known at this time the group was seeking to attack a major event as part of its actions no direct ties to a terror group are known at this time nor is any specific credible threat in the netherlands currently known the plot was foiled weeks after a stabbing attack in amsterdam occurred which authorities are treating as terrorism the terror threat level in the country remains unchanged and amidst the ongoing heightened threat of terrorism across europe it is advised to remain vigilant in public areas and to report suspicious activity or items to authorities recent developments on thursday seven men were arrested on suspicion of plotting of a major terror attack in the netherlands the raids in arnhem and weert involved nearly police officers including anti terror units of the special interventions service dsi during searches of the suspects residence following the arrests police found five handguns about pounds of fertilizer for possible use in a car bomb and a high volume of materials for making explosives to be used in bomb vests prosecutors said the suspects had sought to obtain ak rifles handguns grenades bomb vests and the raw materials for creating explosives the suspects are also believed to have sought opportunities to train with weapons though it was not immediately clear whether they had indeed done so already authorities believe the group wanted to target a large event to inflict higher casualties while plotting to detonate a car bomb at a separate location no exact targets were initially specified by officials and investigations are ongoing regarding the group s possible targets local media had reported that one of the suspects had been detained prior to thursday and released without being charged for photographing a military airbase where he had been employed the suspects are between and years of age and the ringleader is believed to be year old hardi n of iraqi background three of the suspects are from arnhem two from rotterdam one from huissen and one from vlaardingen three of the suspects including the purported ringleader had been convicted previously for attempting to travel to the fighting area where islamic state is is active no known affiliation to a terror group was initially reported by officials the national coordinator for counterterrorism and security said a concrete threat from a terrorist network had been removed the general intelligence and security service aivd had issued an official message regarding the suspected ringleader back in april and the group had been under investigation for several months background the netherlands has not been struck by the same level of islamic extremist violence as has been perpetrated in france germany belgium and the united kingdom in recent years nonetheless extremists remain active and some may seek to carry out attacks in the netherlands or elsewhere in europe following the territorial losses of extremist groups in the middle east a recent attack in amsterdam wounded two americans at the central train station the assailant was a year old afghan residing in germany and authorities said he had acted on an extremist motive in response to the terror threat in recent years the government has sought to boost data sharing and interoperability between law enforcement entities and has bolstered security measures around sensitive locations on public transportation and at major events assessment following the arrests prime minister mark rutte said the attack plot underscores the importance of remaining vigilant of the ongoing threat of terrorism the terror threat level in the netherlands has been maintained at level four substantial out of a maximum severity of five no specific credible threat is known at this time though there is an ongoing elevated risk of a terror attack in the netherlands and across europe extremist groups such as islamic state continue to encourage supporters to carry out attacks in europe and fighters returning from conflict areas in the middle east also continue to pose a risk far right dutch politician geert wilders continues to draw condemnation from muslims for anti islamic remarks and controversial activities potentially garnering increased attention to the netherlands from extremists thursday s arrests and the months long monitoring of the group highlight the trend that sophisticated plots with several people involved are often more susceptible to detection by authorities in contrast an attack by a lone person wielding readily accessible weapons such as knives as occurred in the amsterdam train station attack is difficult to detect and thwart in advance there is not believed to be any ongoing threat emanating from the arrest of the group on thursday nonetheless resilience customers are advised to exercise caution in crowded and high profile locations and to report suspicious behavior or items to local authorities further police operations remain possible as investigations into the group s preparations and background continue and it is advised to avoid any associated police activity

hong kong human rights bill likely to further complicate u s china relationship if enacted on tuesday the u s senate passed the hong kong human rights and democracy act with unanimous consent the bill requires the u s department of state to report to congress annually if hong kong s special status should be continued and if it is sufficiently autonomous from mainland china the report will address civil liberties and how any erosion of hong kong s autonomy would affect relations between the u s and hong kong those who violate human rights including acts like extrajudicial rendition or torture would be barred from entering the u s and would face sanctions the u s house of representatives which passed a similar bill in october has said that they will attempt to pass the senate bill which should make it quicker for the bill to be presented to president donald trump for his signature or veto beijing criticized the bill as being a violation of international law while the hong kong government also expressed opposition and said that any unilateral changes of u s economic and trade policy could impact the u s companies and u s residents in hong kong the text of the senate bill can be found here assessment hong kong s special status is rooted in the united states hong kong policy act of which recognizes the different legal social and economic systems that differentiate it from mainland china this has resulted in benefits like not being subjected to u s china trade tariffs and easier travel to the u s for hong kong passport holders companies enjoy economic benefits as well which also includes more transparent legal and arbitration mechanisms those in the u s shipped u s billion to hong kong last year and hong kong exported more than u s billion in services with a significant portion of that originating from hong kong branches of u s companies providing services to mainland china it remains unclear if president trump will sign the bill as he has personally refrained from strongly supporting the protesters in hong kong there were also media reports that president trump had promised chinese president xi jinping in june that he would refrain from commenting on the protests while trade negotiations were taking place if president trump decides to sign the bill it would likely be seen by china as a breaking of that promise and would negatively affect trade talks while both the house and senate versions of the bill were passed by unanimous consent which would theoretically be enough to override a presidential veto it remains unclear what would happen if president trump expressed his personal opposition to the bill customers are advised to closely monitor the progress of the bill as its passage could lower chances of a substantive trade agreement and includes the possibility of tariff or non tariff restrictions being put on u s companies or products by china

robbers continue to target freight trains in mexico cargo theft particularly from freight trains continues to be a significant threat to supply chains in mexico the scale of goods moving through mexico s freight railway system makes it hard for supply chain security personnel to track everything with precision with tracks crossing through extremely isolated areas such as the sonora dessert in the north or densely populated areas such puebla or toluca in the center of the country train robberies are a thriving business in mexico and just about any type of cargo from electric appliances and auto parts to grains chemicals and cement is at risk it is a phenomenon that not only affects cargo and infrastructure but also the wellbeing of drivers and security personnel past studies have estimated that cargo worth hundreds of millions of dollars is lost annually in mexico in train hijackings and robberies theft operations have also become more complex in recent years in the past thieves usually identified areas where freight trains either stop or slow down to jump on pop open doors or trailers and throw products off in the last few months however mexico has seen an increasing number of choreographed train robberies that often start with robbers damaging tracks or holding up trains with rocks and involve small armies of people who descend on the derailed cars in waves to carry off the loot train robberies in mexico have reached alarming levels in from january to september mexico s railway transport regulatory agency artf reported a total of train robberies which represents a percent increase compared to the robberies recorded during the same period in in other words the frequency of robberies increased from a week to a week in the space of a year the regulatory agency also reported that the five states with the most robberies are puebla guanajuato jalisco coahuila and sonora one industry that has been particularly affected by the surge of train robberies in mexico is the chemicals industry in tlaxcala puebla and veracruz stealing gasoline and diesel from pipelines has not been enough for organized bands of huachicoleros fuel thieves who have turned their eyes to cargo theft from trains as an opportunity to expand their tentacles to other underground markets products such as pesticides ethylene polyvinyl chloride polyethylene and other polymers are routinely targeted by these criminal organizations especially along the mexico city puebla veracruz route the mexico city saltillo route and the mexiquense beltway polyethylene a thermoplastic polymer heavily used in the production of consumer products is by far the most targeted chemical product in mexico in the etileno xxi petrochemical complex in coatzacoalcos veracruz alone reported losses of usd million eur million due to polyethylene theft this year there have a number of train robberies targeting polyethylene shipments the most noticeable thefts occurred in february and may with tons of polyethylene worth approximately usd eur stolen in the town of apizaco and tons of polyethylene worth approximately usd eur stolen in tamariz respectively this extensive criminal activity is supported by an underground market ready to receive and sell polyethylene to consumers the towns of tezuapan and san antonio la soledad in the state of puebla have been identified as two of the main points of sale for stolen chemicals in the country reports indicate that in these towns stolen polyethylene is sold at around usd eur per kilo well below its market value of usd eur per kilo security concerns in mexico especially for rail transportation are not going away anytime soon shippers and carriers likewise are waiting to see if the country s incoming administration is prepared to take steps to stop the increasing rail cargo thefts in the meantime supply chain managers with interests in mexico must continue collaborating with other members of the value chain both upstream and downstream and make use of technology that provide visibility on evolving supply chain security risks moreover railroad carriers must be constantly evaluated and monitored to determine if they are exposed to a higher than normal risk while companies must continuously assess their shipping routes to find the best way to eliminate or mitigate those risks

increase in trade circumvention practices to evade u s tariffs on chinese imports over recent weeks several alleged cases of trade circumvention by foreign companies mostly believed to be from china have been reported in vietnam and cambodia these companies are allegedly transshipping and re routing exported goods through third party countries in a bid to evade u s tariffs during a period of ongoing trade tensions between the united states and china on june vietnamese customs published a notice stating that it would be cracking down on goods of chinese origin illegally relabeled made in vietnam by exporters seeking to avoid u s tariffs imposed on chinese imports amid trade tensions saigon also announced that it has instructed its provincial and municipal branches to increase inspection and verification of certificates of origin to better identify and impose penalties on businesses that carry out such violations subsequent reports followed on june when the u s fined several chinese companies for exporting goods via sihanoukville special economic zone ssez a chinese owned sez in cambodia in another similar alleged attempt to dodge u s tariffs on chinese goods cambodia s commerce ministry has denied these allegations after issuing a statement on june stating that the u s claims were baseless and that the operating procedures in such economic zones was clear the trump administration has made it a key priority to tackle transshipment aimed at evading u s tariffs a practice in which chinese made goods are minimally processed or briefly altered in a third port before being re exported as a product originating from the third port the advent of transshipment and other trade circumvention methods threaten to hamper washington s plans to enforce its latest round of percent tariffs on usd billion eur billion worth of chinese imports and a potential further round of tariffs on usd billion eur billion of chinese imports the u s customs and border protection cbp has also reportedly identified similar recent cases of illegal transshipment of chinese goods in vietnam malaysia cambodia and the philippines as well as in non asian countries such as serbia and mexico made in vietnam packaging labels vietnam alleges that there have been numerous reported instances of some importers illegally repackaging goods from china with fake made in vietnam country of origin packaging labels these goods then apply for a vietnamese certificate of origin and are eventually exported to american european and japanese markets vietnamese customs authorities cited in a statement that the illegal transshipment of goods happens most often in the sectors of textiles seafood agricultural products honey steel and iron aluminum and timber products the allegations of transshipment cases appear to be supported by recent trade data over the first four months in u s imports from china have fallen by percent while imports from vietnam grew by percent over the same period from january to may sharp increases in exports from china to vietnam of electronics computers machinery and other equipment have been reported with vietnamese exports to u s for such goods also rising heavily within the same period for instance vietnam s imports of computers and electronics from china have increased by percent from last year while vietnam s exports to the u s of the same products increased by percent similar cases were also reported last year as part of the trump administration s efforts to target illegal transshipment of chinese exports of steel and furniture via vietnam thailand and malaysia in may the u s imposed duties of more than percent on certain vietnamese steel exports due to a significant portion containing chinese steel routing goods through cambodia s special economic zone on june the u s embassy in cambodia released a statement indicating that the department of homeland security has inspected and fined a number of companies for evading tariffs in the united states by routing goods through cambodia these companies were reportedly located in cambodia s ssez although u s officials declined to name or say how many companies had been fined for avoiding the tariffs how large the fines were or what goods the companies had been exporting the ssez is kilometers miles west of phnom penh and is a chinese and cambodian joint venture in the belt and road initiative which exports predominantly textiles garments bags and leather products the latest developments of alleged trade circumvention could have dire consequences for cambodia under a current trade agreement with the u s the generalized system of preferences which was expanded in allows for goods from cambodia particularly garments textiles and travel goods to be exported to the u s duty free phnom penh which is already facing a potential suspension from another similar trade program from the eu could see its privileges revoked under the gsp which could directly impact the ability of foreign manufacturers to continue to export goods duty free particularly in the textiles and garments sectors according to the u s embassy there have been two cases since of companies operating in the ssez being charged with anti dumping duties after having been found to transport transshipped goods such as chemical glycine and steel pipe fittings trade circumvention practices may persist the latest reports on transshipment and other trade circumvention practices in cambodia and vietnam highlight a growing trend among foreign companies particularly chinese exporters and suppliers that may be looking for avenues to skirt the u s tariffs during an uncertain regulatory climate although neither cambodia nor vietnam provides specific details on the identity of the companies total volume of goods being transshipped or major industries involved there is reasonable evidence to believe that cases of alleged circumvention of u s tariffs could be far reaching in third party regions such as southeast asia and beyond from a supply chain perspective the rise of trade circumvention practices for the purposes of evading u s tariffs is problematic on a number of fronts given the growing trend of multinational companies contemplating shifting production from china to southeast asia such practices can expose these manufacturers to substantial legal and criminal penalties foreign manufacturers will therefore need to ensure that these production shifts are well documented and supply chain professionals will need to work collaboratively with their respective trade and compliance departments to ensure that supplier vetting sanctions and due diligence is sufficiently covered if transshipment cases were ever to occur supply chain managers are advised to later a female suicide bomber detonated her explosives after being stopped by a soldier while attempting to enter the cordoned area near the site of the first explosion the two explosions killed at stated that the soldiers were following up on reports that two female suicide bombers were operating in sulu and theorized that the police officers who killed the soldiers may be related to abu sayyaf members the investigation into the exact nature of the shooting remains ongoing and in addition to the possibility of mistaken identity officials have also previously stated that the soldiers killings may have been related to drugs or a local dispute regardless of the circumstances surrounding the deaths of the soldiers if they were investigating reports of the presence of female suicide bombers it is possible that their investigation was related to suspects involved in monday s bombings and could indicate that additional suspects remain outstanding abu sayyaf is based on jolo and operates primarily in sulu and basilan provinces authorities have urged residents to remain vigilant following the jolo attack and to report any suspicious individuals it is likely that searches and other evaluations continue following severe winter storm that killed in mediterranean spain and france on thursday the death toll in spain from a storm locally referred to as storm gloria rose to with an additional four people missing mediterranean coastal areas of spain including catalonia murcia and andalusia and the balearic islands were hardest hit in spain with prime minister pedro sanchez surveying heavily impacted areas on thursday ahead of a government emergency meeting on friday as response measures are ongoing the storm brought wind gusts in excess of miles per hour along with heavy rain and strong waves the majority of storm related deaths occurred in catalonia and valencia while the storm had moved from spain several rivers in the country s northeast burst their banks on thursday and rice paddies in the ebro river delta between barcelona and valencia were hard hit from a storm surge that extended about two miles inland the storm also brought snow to the pyrenees and flooding to lower elevation areas of southern france though no related fatalities in france are known in france s pyr n es orientales and aude departments as much as five months of rain has fallen within three days prompting more than evacuations assessment prime minister sanchez said that climate change is accentuating storms such as gloria while forecasters in france noted that gloria was the worst winter storm to strike the region since france and spain experienced heavy flooding in october however and both the intensity and frequency of such storms are generally believed to be hallmarks of climate change such storms are capable of disrupting regional transportation damaging coastal infrastructure and exacerbating erosion that can leave coastal areas more vulnerable to future severe weather events in more mountainous regions the heavy snowfall from storm systems typically heightens the risk of avalanches and data from local officials regarding any restricted areas should be observed while damage assessments and recovery efforts continue in both france and spain it is advised to continue monitoring river levels in affected areas for any further flood risk to avoid any persisting areas of high water including while driving and to heed the guidance of local authorities

strike coincides with the carnaval holiday in brazil brazilian supply chains and transportation thoroughfares like many locales which commemorate the holiday slow down and gradually resume production after ash wednesday manufacturers traditionally give employees time off for the carnaval period with typical holiday duration lasting for about week starting on the preceding friday in extreme cases the holiday may even extend to days sources state that the port management and sindestiva representatives willing to meet and negotiate during the holiday is unlikely at best while past incidents impacting the port of santos have been relatively harmless this open ended strike over a longer period without any negotiation in sight poses greater uncertainty such uncertainty without a resolution is likely to cause cargo delays and subsequent backlogs as such those relying on the port of santos as a maritime hub are advised to monitor developments while strikes of this nature typically make provisions for the unimpeded circulation of perishable and element sensitive goods no such provisions have been explicitly mentioned at present

uk to extend immigration possibilities if national security laws implemented in hong kong in an article published on wednesday british prime minister boris johnson reemphasized plans released last week by the home office to extend immigration possibilities to british national overseas bno passport holders if national security legislation passed by china s national people s congress npc is implemented in hong kong the home office plans include extending united kingdom visa free travel for hong kong bno passport holders and their dependents to months with the possibility for renewal up from the current six months and to allow bno passport holders to work in the uk which could eventually lead to citizenship the bno designation was granted to hong kong residents who chose to receive it before the handover of hong kong to china and to those who acquired the status when the handover took effect according to the home office there are approximately bno passport holders in hong kong with nearly three million other people eligible to apply for bno passports assessment the security legislation that was approved by the npc has been controversial both for sidestepping hong kong s legislative council and for the view that it will be used to end the semi autonomy that hong kong has enjoyed since the handover media sources have reported long lines of people attempting to apply for or renew bno passports at postal offices and shipping businesses in hong kong in recent days uk foreign secretary dominic raab stated on tuesday that the uk government had also spoken with the united states australia canada and new zealand over the possibility of mass emigration from hong kong if the npc laws are implemented and a possible joint response by those countries to such a largescale departure on monday the us department of state released remarks from secretary mike pompeo in which he said that the us is taking a look at increasing the number of arrivals it accepts from hong kong an idea that was also supported by senate leader mitch mcconnell the government of taiwan has also indicated that it is willing to resettle additional people from hong kong chinese and hong protests against police use of force devolve into violent unrest across colombia more riots likely from wednesday night through thursday morning a wave of protests erupted throughout colombia numerous demonstrations devolved into broader episodes of unrest entailing arson and or violent altercations with security forces the catalyst behind the tumult was the death of year old law student javier ordo ez which occurred the previous night according to bogot police commander colonel alexander amaya tuesday evening s incident began when colombian national police pnc officers responded to a group of intoxicated individuals who were arguing in the street in bogot s villa luz neighborhood amaya claims that some members of the group became aggressive towards police officers placed ordo ez under arrest and witnesses recorded the incident on video the recording depicts ordo ez being pinned to the ground and tased by two police officers shortly thereafter ordo ez was pronounced dead while in police custody the video of his arrest was widely circulated on social media the following day a range of activist groups organized protests against police use of force on wednesday in cities including bogot medell n barranquilla and cali as nightfall came crowds at many demonstrations grew increasingly unruly rioting ensued in multiple locations with the worst unrest being reported in bogot particularly in the districts of bosa engativ suba and kennedy demonstrators threw molotov cocktails at police substations cais and engaged in widespread vandalism of public property security forces responded with tear gas and rubber bullets and in some cases with live ammunition although estimates regarding casualties have been subject to variation local news outlets have reported that as many as eight protesters were killed nationwide two of the deceased demonstrators were reportedly killed by gunshots in the city of soacha which borders bogot to the southwest bogot municipal authorities report that protesters were wounded across the capital including individuals who sustained gunshot wounds pnc spokesmen have indicated that officers were wounded in the clashes media sources report that at least cais were destroyed police motorcycles were damaged and eight transmilenio city buses were set on fire authorities report that arrests were made in bogot in madrid six in ibagu three in mosquera one in medell n and one in cali assessment defense minister carlos holmes trujillo held a press conference on thursday morning he condemned acts of excessive use of force among law enforcement but also noted that various social media accounts were actively fomenting unrest and encouraging vandalism throughout the country bogot mayor claudia l pez has claimed that the pnc is in need of major structural reforms stating that complaints of police abuse so far this year in bogot are not isolated cases additional street manifestations have been planned across the country for thursday night tensions throughout bogot and other large cities across colombia will almost certainly remain elevated in the coming days and possibly weeks and the potential for further public demonstrations will remain high the public is advised to frequently monitor local news outlets as impromptu bouts of protest activity could potentially crop up with little or no warning all large crowds should be avoided as much as possible as even demonstrations that are intended to be peaceful can rapidly escalate and devolve into violent rioting

consulates continue to monitor closely covid conditions in japan case numbers continue to rise throughout the country several areas including tokyo are posting record or near record numbers daily has allegedly blocked australian coal from clearing customs the news sparked speculations and prompted most chinese traders to stop ordering coal from the land down under while some reports have cited safety and quality as the reasons for the customs delays others suggested that diplomatic tensions between the two countries are likely to be a factor as of this writing there have been no official statement by beijing or by the port s authorities pertaining to the bilateral trade situation concerning australian coal imports into china both governments dismissed allegations about a ban though industry experts have noted that there appeared to be a noticeable prolonged inspection of australian coal at the port s customs according to reports the current clearance time for australian coal is up to days when it normally takes anywhere between to days currently only coal imports to dalian have been affected other ports in china are accepting coal shipments from elsewhere including australia chinese authorities have confirmed that local customs officials have stepped up efforts to monitor the quality and safety of imported coals in recent years as they reportedly does not meet the environmental standards while the lengthy inspection implies that australian coal may have either dropped below the chinese quality threshold or the standards have become higher it is important to note that this is not the first time china has put brakes on accepting imported coal back in it restricted indonesian coal imports for being high in impurities and low in energy efficiency although it remains unclear why the port of dalian is the only port with longer clearance time at the moment precedents show that chuanshon anchorage at ningbo port and zhoushan lng import terminal near shanghai evident that it is determined to control coal imports for environmental protection as well as to balance out an oversupply of coal in the local market in november coal prices dropped one third when china banned coal imports from around the world until early due to an oversupply of coal in the domestic market with this backdrop dalian port authorities have set a cap of million tons for the world s coal imports for via its terminals possibly to slow down the intake this is a reduction from last year when it handled million tons with half of the amount being from australia dalian customs growing opposition movement calls for demonstrations later this month a meeting has been called for october by the party alliance of opposition parties in pakistan known as the pakistan democratic government corruption rising inflation unemployment and deteriorating living conditions in the country in addition to these grievances the opposition movement seems to be fueled by the arrest of several senior members of pakistan s political elite indeed on september shehbaz sharif the leader of the opposition pakistan muslim league nawaz pml n was arrested on corruption charges in lahore protests against the arrest of shehbaz sharif are expected on october in lahore and october in the rest of punjab shehbaz sharif was previously arrested in october in a separate corruption case while he was chief minister of the punjab province his older brother nawaz sharif who previously held the position of prime minister three times was forced to resign in july after the country s supreme court ruled that he had lied on a parliamentary wealth declaration he was later convicted in two corruption cases nawaz left the country for london on medical bail last november but has not returned since several other senior members of the pml n party have been arrested during khan s premiership and this strategy has been criticized by opponents as merely an avenue to strike down political resistance protests against khan s administration were also reported in november demanding his resignation though the movement fizzled out and no major reforms were realized the current movement has clean_text: us official alleged that hezbollah has had caches of ammonium nitrate in several european countries the united states coordinator for counterterrorism nathan sales stated during a conference on thursday september that lebanon based militant group hezbollah had arranged multiple caches of ammonium nitrate around europe and has used european routes to transport this material the substance was purportedly being transported disguised as cold packs within first aid kits sales alleged that transport of ammonium nitrate through europe was facilitated until at least with some stores of the material remaining in place at unknown locations while others have been destroyed by authorities the countries mentioned reportedly include belgium spain and switzerland as transit routes and france greece italy spain switzerland and the united kingdom as storage locations the french ministry of foreign affairs responded to these claims the next day stating that such activity has not been confirmed within the country and that illegal activity committed by foreign organizations on french territory would be dealt with by local authorities with the greatest firmness during the conference sales also urged european leaders to impose bans on all hezbollah organizations including the political wing which several european governments such as belgium italy greece france spain and switzerland have not designated as a terrorist organization both the militant and political wings of hezbollah have been designated as terrorist organizations by the us the uk and germany assessment in past years several raids have been conducted in response to reports of ammonium nitrate being stored by hezbollah across europe a warehouse that was raided in cyprus in was found to have housed more than eight tons of ammonium nitrate the same year an operation involving raids of four safe houses in london uncovered approximately three tons of the substance links between the compound and hezbollah operatives include the fact that the explosive charge used in the suicide bombing at burgas airport in bulgaria which killed six and injured contained ammonium nitrate aside from the alleged storage of compounds with applications as explosives hezbollah s presence in europe also includes human operatives as well as a financial network while designating the political wing of the organization as a terrorist organization could create restrictions to its operations in europe there have been allegations that some european governments such as france have not given such a designation in order to protect nationals and key business connections based in lebanon however countries that have banned the entirety of hezbollah continue to see organizational activity within their borders the number of hezbollah recruits in germany has reportedly been increasing in recent years following the august explosion at the port of beirut caused by a large amount of ammonium nitrate there may be enhanced focus by security authorities on the identification of caches of this specific compound while no specific credible threat is known at this time it is advised to continue to monitor developments including any possible future raids on facilities suspected of storing potentially dangerous substances and any developments related to hezbollah s classification by european governments

clean_text: migrant workers others being transported home as india extends lockdown on friday india extended its covid lockdown to at least may it was originally set to be lifted after may while business and travel restrictions will remain in place throughout much of the country areas classified as lower risk will see some regulations lifted friday also saw the beginning of a government push to relocate migrant workers students pilgrims tourists and others who were caught away from their homes when the lockdown first went into effect a train left the hyderabad area friday morning transporting around migrant workers to hatia in the state of jharkhand another train was scheduled to depart kerala for odisha later on friday some buses have also been put into service transporting people who had been stranded away from home and ferries are operating between chennai and the andaman and nicobar islands to facilitate returns such trips must be organized by the central or state level governments as private interstate travel remains mostly blocked during the lockdown assessment workers or other returning passengers are receiving temperature checks and being screened for other covid symptoms before being allowed to board their trains or other forms of transportation and police have been deployed at stations to ensure there are no unauthorized passengers social distancing measures are also being taken on trains with train cars carrying fewer people than normal and returnees being separated into smaller groups to make the journeys many states have been making preparations for the expected return of large numbers of migrant workers and most of them will be quarantined for days upon their arrivals back home the government has faced pressure from migrant workers in particular who have sought to return to their hometowns from the cities they work in since the start of the lockdown the workers transported out of hyderabad friday morning were themselves involved in a violent protest earlier this week demanding to return to their homes providing transportation for migrant workers and others who have been stranded away from their homes during the lockdown could help to reduce tensions in some areas where large numbers of workers have been stuck however there is also the potential for additional unrest or altercations with police if large numbers of travelers attempt to gather at transit hubs or if some groups are not given transportation as soon as they would like transportation for these groups also raises the prospect of further spread of covid especially in the case of migrant workers most of whom will be departing from cities which have been the epicenters of the outbreak in india to smaller towns and more rural locations which have been relatively less affected although travelers will receive health screenings before their departures there is the potential for asymptomatic cases to slip through in addition although many returning travelers will face quarantines when returning home there have been reports of returning migrant workers in rural areas leaving quarantines early or coming and going at will on the other hand officially registering and transporting workers across state borders using government transportation may help to cut the number of unsanctioned interstate crossings that some state officials have expressed concern about individuals are advised to expect possible traffic increases around transit centers and to continue to follow all guidelines and restrictions issued by local authorities

update city council approves declaration of support for nobel plastiques workers updated media sources indicate on september that the board of cornell de llobregat city council barcelona has approved a declaration of support for the workers of nobel plastiques ib rica de sant joan desp who went strike after the company announced the closure of the plant the decision to close the plant will affect workers nobel plastiques ib rica is a subsidiary of the turkish group orhan holding and is dedicated to manufacturing automotive parts nobel plastiques develops and manufactures plastic and rubber automotive products the company creates lines and tubes for the transfer of fluids and specialty plastic shaping tools the strike has forced renault to suspend its afternoon shifts earlier this month at its villamuriel de cerrato factory and has also affected the valladolid assembly plant renault officials said that if the nobel strike were to be prolonged it will order parts from other suppliers to meet demand
